build_SCNet_backbone: build an SCNet backbone with depth 50 or 101 for pose estimation feature extraction
create_SCConv_layer: create a Self-calibrated Convolution layer with configurable pooling radius and stride for feature calibration
create_SCBottleneck_block: create an SC Bottleneck block that splits features into two branches with SCConv for pose networks
run_SCNet_forward: run forward pass through SCNet backbone to extract multi-scale feature maps from input images
review_SCBottleneck_forward: review the SCBottleneck forward method that uses gradient checkpointing for memory-efficient training
